crossRefs.note: He shall offer of the sacrifice of peace offerings an offering made by fire to Yahweh. The fat that covers the innards…
The priest shall burn them on the altar: it is the food of the offering made by fire, for a pleasant aroma; all the fat…
For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering…
whose end is destruction, whose god is the belly, and whose glory is in their shame, who think about earthly things.
These are hidden rocky reefs in your love feasts when they feast with you, shepherds who without fear feed themselves…

parallels.note: The fat of the sin offering he shall burn on the altar.

translations.web: Yes, before they burned the fat, the priest’s servant came, and said to the man who sacrificed, “Give meat to roast for the priest; for he will not accept boiled meat from you, but raw.”
translations.bsb: Even before the fat was burned, the servant of the priest would come and say to the man who was sacrificing, “Give the priest some meat to roast, because he will not accept boiled meat from you, but only raw.”
translations.kjv: Also before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have sodden flesh of thee, but raw.
translations.asv: Yea, before they burnt the fat, the priest's servant came, and said to the man that sacrificed, Give flesh to roast for the priest; for he will not have boiled flesh of thee, but raw.
